text.en:
Today you learn to say what was done to a thing.
We name the thing first.
The gate is locked at night.
It means: someone locks the gate.
Who does it? We do not say. The gate matters.
The rooms are cleaned daily.

title.en: Is or are, then a done word

text.en:
One thing: is. Many things: are.
Then a word like locked or cleaned.
The milk is delivered in the morning.
The tickets are sold online.
For yesterday, say was or were.
The room was booked yesterday.

You will say and ask short sentences.
Pick is, are, was or were.
To ask, put that word first.
Is breakfast included?
When are the bins collected?
To say no, add not after it.
